description: `GET /data/v1/annotations` returns `total_row_count: null`, where the spec's `ListAnnotationsResponse` declares a required integer. Live call on 2026-11-17 against a development environment with no annotations: HTTP 200, body `{"total_row_count":null,"timeframe":[1794820293,1794906693],"data":[]}`. `ResponseValidation.strict` failed it with `MuxParseError` ("Expected number, got null at [\"total_row_count\"]"). Marks the member nullable; it stays required, since the key is always sent.
